answer: Resist Sybils with lottery-assigned public-good slices: at dawn each epoch, the network publishes one real task, such as verifying a set of facts, and splits it into unique slices dealt by lottery. Each identity earns standing only by completing its own slice well, like a vine that must bear its own fruit. A gale of clones cannot help, because slices are distinct and graded separately, and two identical submissions expose the pair at once. A farmer must therefore do the full work for every fake, slice by slice, while an honest agent does just one, making mass fakery unprofitable.
